content.value_statement: HyperFrames animation work needs precise GSAP timing, effects, and performance choices. This skill gives focused references for tweens, timelines, typewriter text, and audio-reactive visuals.
actual_capabilities: Explains core GSAP tween methods, including to, from, fromTo, and set.
Shows timeline structure with defaults, labels, nesting, and position parameters.
Provides transform, easing, stagger, and playback guidance for animation code.
Documents responsive and reduced-motion patterns with gsap.matchMedia.
Includes HyperFrames-specific typewriter and audio visualizer effect patterns.
Includes a helper script that extracts audio frame data with ffmpeg and numpy.
limitations: It is a reference skill and does not render or test animations by itself.
The audio extraction helper requires local ffmpeg, Python, and numpy.
Example CDN script tags depend on external jsdelivr availability.
It does not cover every GSAP plugin or advanced licensing topic.

use_cases.title: Build a Motion Sequence
use_cases.description: Create a GSAP timeline with clear labels, defaults, and coordinated element entrances.

use_cases.title: Add Text Reveal Effects
use_cases.description: Use typewriter patterns with cursor states, backspacing, word rotation, and multiline handoff timing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Audio-Reactive Visuals
use_cases.description: Extract frame-based audio data and map RMS or frequency bands to visual animation properties.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Tween
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GSAP skill to animate this element from hidden to visible. Prefer transform and opacity properties.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Timeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GSAP skill to build a timeline plan with defaults, labels, staggered entries, and playback control.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Typewriter Effect
prompt_templates.scenario: Text reveal in a HyperFrames composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GSAP effects reference to create a typewriter sequence with cursor blink, hold, and backspace behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Audio Visualizer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GSAP skill to plan audio data extraction and map frequency bands to a deterministic visualizer timeline.

output_examples.input: Animate three product cards into view with readable timing.
output_examples.output: A concise timeline plan using transform-based movement, opacity, staggered starts, and labels for later control.

output_examples.input: Create a headline that types and replaces several words.
output_examples.output: A typewriter sequence that defines cursor states, typing speed, hold timing, and safe backspace behavior.

output_examples.input: Make visuals respond to an audio track in HyperFrames.
output_examples.output: An audio visualizer approach with extracted frame data, RMS-driven global motion, and band-driven detail changes.

best_practices: Use transforms, opacity, and autoAlpha before layout-changing properties.
Use timelines, labels, and position parameters for readable sequencing.
Respect reduced-motion preferences and clean up unused tweens or timelines.
anti_patterns: Do not chain many animations with manual delays when a timeline fits better.
Do not animate width, height, top, or left when transforms can create the same result.
Do not build HyperFrames timelines inside asynchronous callbacks.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build GSAP tweens, timelines, typewriter effects, and audio-reactive visual patterns for HyperFrames.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: It includes reference snippets and one Python helper script for extracting audio visualization data.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the audio helper need extra software?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper requires Python, numpy, and ffmpeg installed on the local system.

faq.question: Is this a general GSAP manual?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on practical GSAP patterns that fit HyperFrames composition rules.

faq.question: Can it handle accessibility needs?
faq.answer: It includes a gsap.matchMedia example that accounts for reduced-motion preferences.
